nextGame.note: Saturday home game at Yulman Stadium against North Texas. Eleven o'clock in the morning, on ESPNU. Tulane has won five games and lost five, and one more win puts the Green Wave in a bowl game. North Texas has won seven games and lost three.

news.headline: Tulane's last road game is set for 2:30 Saturday
news.summary: Tulane plays at South Florida on Saturday, November 28, at half past two in the afternoon. The game is on ESPN+, which comes with YouTube TV at no extra charge.

news.headline: Tulane's Saturday kickoff is set for 11 in the morning
news.summary: Tulane plays North Texas at Yulman Stadium at 11 o'clock Saturday morning, on ESPNU. A win sends the Green Wave to a bowl game.

news.headline: Tulane wins at Rice 20-17 after a bus ride
news.summary: Friday's nationwide halt on flights meant Tulane rode a bus to Houston and got in around two in the morning. Bredell Richardson caught a 24-yard pass from Trace Johnson in the fourth quarter for the winning points, and the Green Wave are now five wins and five losses.

nextGame.note: Saturday morning home game in Gainesville. Eleven o'clock our time, on the SEC Network. It is Florida's last home game of the year. Florida has won six games and lost four and is already going to a bowl game. Vanderbilt has won four games and lost six.

news.headline: Aaron Philo wins two awards for his game at Kentucky
news.summary: The Southeastern Conference named Philo its best offensive player of the week, and the Davey O'Brien award put him on its list of the eight best quarterbacks in the country. He threw for 119 yards and ran for 102 at Kentucky, the first Florida quarterback to run for a hundred yards in a game since 2022.

news.headline: Aaron Philo will keep starting for Florida
news.summary: Coach Jon Sumrall said Aaron Philo starts Saturday against Vanderbilt. He said Philo will probably start the rest of the season if he keeps playing the way he did at Kentucky.

news.headline: Florida tight end Lacota Dippre hurt his ankle
news.summary: Lacota Dippre hurt his ankle in the third quarter at Kentucky and did not go back in. Coach Jon Sumrall called the injury pretty substantial and said Dippre had an MRI.

nextGame.note: Saturday afternoon home game in Austin. Half past two our time. Texas has won eight games and lost two. Arkansas has won four games and lost six.

news.headline: Jelani McDonald wins two awards after three interceptions
news.summary: McDonald took the ball away from LSU three times Saturday and tied for the team lead with 11 tackles. His conference named him the best defensive player of the week, and the Associated Press named him the best in the country.

news.headline: Arch Manning will walk with the seniors Saturday
news.summary: Texas honors its seniors before Saturday's home game against Arkansas, and Manning said Monday he will take part. He also said he is not thinking about next year yet, and walking on senior day does not stop him from coming back.

news.headline: Hero Kanu had arm surgery and is out for the season
news.summary: Texas defensive tackle Hero Kanu had surgery on his arm Monday. Coach Steve Sarkisian said Kanu is done for the season.

nextGame.note: Sunday road game at Chicago. Noon our time, on Fox 8. Chicago has won seven games and lost two. The Saints have won three and lost six, and Carolina leads the division with four wins and five losses.

news.headline: Asim Richards will miss a few weeks with a knee injury
news.summary: The right tackle hurt his knee against Carolina on Sunday and will be out a few weeks, Kellen Moore said Monday. Rookie Mason Murphy took his place, and the Saints are already missing their center and their other starting tackle.

news.headline: Kellen Moore says he will call plays more aggressively
news.summary: The Saints did not score in the first half and lost 20-17, and on Monday the head coach said the play calling has to change. He said he needs to be more aggressive and find ways to get the ball down the field.

news.headline: Pete Werner hurt his hamstring against Carolina
news.summary: The Saints linebacker left in the first half and did not come back. Coach Kellen Moore said it is his left hamstring and the team is still checking on him.

nextGame.note: Friday's first game of the national tournament, against Lock Haven. Half past twelve our time, half past one theirs. The games are at the Highmark Events Center in Erie, Pennsylvania, at Gannon, who beat IUP for the conference title on Sunday. IUP got in anyway as the second seed in its region, and Lock Haven has won twenty games and lost seven. Every IUP volleyball game is shown on the free PSAC Sports Digital Network app, so tap the link above on game day and look for the match. You can also search PSAC on a phone, an Apple TV or a Fire TV, or open psacsportsdigitalnetwork.com/iupathletics in a browser. Gannon is hosting this one and has not posted its channel yet, so look under Gannon on the app as well. If IUP wins Friday it plays again Saturday at three o'clock our time, and the winner of the region plays Sunday at three.

news.headline: IUP makes the national tournament and plays Friday
news.summary: IUP is the second seed in the Atlantic Region and plays Lock Haven on Friday in Erie, Pennsylvania. The match starts at half past twelve our time.

news.headline: Peyton Belcher had 6 kills against Gannon
news.summary: Peyton was back on the court Saturday night for the first time since October 23. She played three of the four sets and had 6 kills on 23 swings with 3 errors, plus a block at the net.

news.headline: Peyton Belcher is named a Provost Scholar
news.summary: IUP put Peyton on its fall list of Provost Scholars, which the school gives to juniors and seniors with a grade average of 3.5 or better. A student can only get it once, and she is studying psychology.

nextGame.note: Baseball is finished until the spring. The Yankees open the new season at home against Toronto on Thursday, March 25, at twenty-five to one in the afternoon. No channel has been announced yet.

news.headline: Brett Gardner is on the Hall of Fame ballot
news.summary: Brett Gardner played 14 seasons and all of them for the Yankees. He is on the Hall of Fame ballot for the first time.

news.headline: Tim Hill is staying with the Yankees
news.summary: The left-handed relief pitcher agreed to a new one-year deal worth 2.25 million dollars. He will be back in the New York bullpen next season.

news.headline: Cam Schlittler wins the Cy Young Award
news.summary: The Yankees right-hander was named the best pitcher in the American League on Wednesday, and all 30 voters put him first. He won 14 games and lost 6, gave up 1.95 runs a game and struck out 239 batters.

news.headline: Evangel ends Warren Easton's season 52-14
news.summary: The Eagles lost Friday night in Shreveport in the first round of the state playoffs. Warren Easton finishes the year with four wins and seven losses.

news.headline: Warren Easton makes the playoffs and will travel to Shreveport
news.summary: The state playoff brackets came out Sunday. Warren Easton is the 21st seed and plays at Evangel in Shreveport, which is the 12th seed.

news.headline: Bonnabel beats Warren Easton 29-28
news.summary: The Eagles lost by one point at home Thursday night in the last game of their regular season. Warren Easton finishes the year 4-6, and the state playoff pairings are not out yet.
